窗口里可以用逗号填多个值，排序规则还可以两个方向都比较；所有组合各成一个候选策略: A window may hold several comma-separated values, and a ranking rule may compare both of its directions; every combination is a candidate strategy, up to 32, leaving out those the rule cannot work with. Several candidates are compared in one of two ways. Holdout: they are compared on the trading days before the holdout alone, and the one with the highest Sharpe ratio is replayed over every day. Rolling: each round compares them over a stretch of training days, the account follows that round's highest Sharpe ratio over the validation days after, and everything moves on by one round.

Daily gross P&L = prior lots × settlement price change × multiplier + each signed fill quantity × (settlement minus fill price) × multiplier. Balance = prior balance + gross P&L − fees. 年化收益按实际秒数除以365.2425天；波动率与夏普使用sqrt(A)缩放，未: Annual return uses actual seconds divided by 365.2425 days. Volatility and Sharpe use sqrt(A) scaling without autocorrelation adjustment. Read-time statistics do not replace published scores.
本记录未提供明确绩效方法上下文。: This record has no explicit performance method context.
先读取原回测，核对其固定身份后再创建评价。: Read the original backtest and confirm its fixed identity before creating an evaluation.
固定原账户事实与本次方法生成正式评价；不重跑原回测，不覆盖原发布评分，不自动产生: Publish a fixed evaluation from the original account facts and the selected method. It neither reruns the backtest nor overwrites published scores, and grants no human conclusion or trading eligibility.
未选择年期数或无风险假设时，分别固定不可计算原因，不从原实验或样本跨度补值。: Missing annual periods or risk-free assumptions retain their individual unavailable reasons; nothing is inferred from the original experiment or sample span.
未评价真实现金流调整: Actual cash-flow adjustment has not been evaluated.
未评价基准与相对表现: Benchmark and relative performance have not been evaluated.
未记录人工支持或不支持结论: No human support or rejection conclusion has been recorded.
未核实真实历史可得性: Actual historical availability has not been verified.
年化收益使用实际秒数和365.2425天；波动率与夏普按sqrt(A)缩放，未作: Annual return uses actual seconds and 365.2425 days. Volatility and Sharpe use sqrt(A) scaling without autocorrelation adjustment.
原生产程序缺证据，不能创建固定评价。: The original producer program has no retained evidence; a fixed evaluation cannot be created.
未证明独立验证资格: Independent validation eligibility has not been established.
原来源已退役，不能创建新评价。: The original source is retired; a new evaluation cannot be created.
接纳不等于发布；结果不确定时保留同一请求ID，先核对原任务。: Admission does not mean publication. If the outcome is uncertain, retain the same request ID and inspect the original task first.
正式评价数值由Research固定发布，页面只格式化显示；修改草稿不会重算或替换: Research publishes the fixed evaluation values; this page only formats them. Draft changes do not recalculate or replace the report.
所选任务没有固定绩效评价结果: The selected task has no fixed performance evaluation result.
未评价风险压力情景: Risk and stress scenarios have not been evaluated.
评价报告导出确认不匹配: The evaluation export receipt does not match the fixed content
导出当前固定绩效及原限制，不是完整统一评价报告；不含账户标识、配置、原行情或完整: Export this fixed performance extract and its limitations. It is not a complete unified evaluation report; account identifiers, configuration, raw market data and full charts are excluded. It is not sent to others and grants no trading qualification.
正在导出固定报告，请勿重复提交: Exporting the fixed report; do not submit again
保存日采样损失路径（不代表盘中最大风险）: Save the daily sampled loss path (not an intraday risk maximum)
仅原日结算观察，不补缺日或初始资金点；本区间首个结算为峰值起点，不代表盘中最大损: Original settlement observations only. No missing days or deposit observations are inserted. The first settlement starts this window; this is not an intraday loss maximum.
非正权益使全路径比例覆盖不完整: Nonpositive equity makes full-path fraction coverage incomplete
曲线仅绘当前页原观察；缺比例处断开，范围外未绘制。间隔数是观察索引差，不是自然日: The chart shows this page only; undefined fractions are disconnected. Intervals are differences between observation indices, not calendar days or complete exchange sessions.
当前页日采样回撤曲线: Daily sampled drawdown on this page
本固定日观察中无回撤片段；不等于无风险。: No drawdown episode in these fixed daily observations; this does not establish absence of risk.
原总手数未记录: Original gross lots were not recorded
所列总名义金额为零，集中度不适用: Listed gross notional is zero; concentration is unavailable
保存本范围末日敞口和资金观察（非盘中峰值）: Save exposure and funds at this window’s last settlement (not intraday peaks)
仅本固定范围末日结算列出的合约；净额不是全部风险，总额未记录时不从净手数推断。保: Only contracts listed at the last settlement of this fixed window. Net exposure is not total risk; missing gross is not inferred from net lots. Margin is not a loss limit or proof that positions can be closed.
原结算资金观察未记录；不从余额、费率或其他时点重构保证金、可用或冻结。: Funds observations were not recorded at this settlement. Margin, available and frozen funds are not reconstructed from balance, rates or another time.
多空手数只按已记录总/净手数精确推导；集中度仅针对所列总名义金额。未归属风险不平: Long/short lots are derived exactly from recorded gross/net lots. Concentration covers listed gross notional only. Unattributed risk is not distributed evenly and margin is not offset across products.
净名义可相抵，双边总额、保证金、基差和退出风险不会因此消失。该切片不含完整策略归: Net notional may offset while gross exposure, margin, basis and exit risks remain. This slice does not include full strategy attribution, tail estimates or stress scenarios and does not change live limits or send orders.
保存显式静态价格与保证金压力: Save explicit static price and margin stress
仅一个原合约且原总手数和资金完整；先选择原末日敞口。无成交、调仓、费用变化或自动: Requires one original contract with recorded gross lots and funds; select original closing exposure first. No fills, rebalancing, fee changes or automatic funding.
明确采用原纸面资金模型：余额与权益取小，减保证金及原冻结: Explicitly use the original paper funds model: minimum of balance and equity, minus margin and original frozen funds
无成交、调仓、费用变化或强平成交证据；假设保证金不是市值损失，也不是现行费率。: No fills, rebalancing, fee changes or liquidation-fill evidence; hypothetical margin is neither mark loss nor a current rate.
原纸面模型；余额及冻结不变，权益按市值变化: Original paper model; balance and frozen funds stay fixed, equity changes with marks
可固定原日采样损失、末日敞口资金及显式单合约静态压力；尾部估计、动态压力和完整策: Fix original daily sampled losses, closing exposure/funds and explicit single-contract static stress. Tail estimates, dynamic stress and full strategy attribution remain unimplemented.
读取固定账户事实并显式保存绩效与所选风险情景；完整归因、尾部、动态压力与独立性仍: Read fixed account facts and explicitly save performance and selected risk scenarios. Full attribution, tail risk, dynamic stress and independence retain gaps; human interpretations are recorded separately.
仅已请求的风险事实或静态情景；完整归因、尾部与动态压力尚未评价: Only requested risk facts or static scenarios; full attribution, tail risk and dynamic stress are not evaluated
完整账户原日线，按实际合约与交易日核对；毛变动包含未平仓结算影响，不是已平仓交易: Original daily full-account evidence, reconciled by actual contract and trading day. Gross changes include settlement of open holdings, not closed-trade profits.
账户本金不分配给合约，不展示未经定义的合约收益率；本表不是策略或方向归因。: Account capital is not allocated to contracts and undefined contract returns are not shown. This is not strategy or direction attribution.
所选合约期末净持仓核对: Selected contract closing net position check
保存原合约贡献（仅完整账户、全部日线）: Save original contract contributions (full account, all daily inputs only)
按原合约与原成交日期解释金额；缺证据拒绝，不分摊账户本金或未解释差额。: Explain amounts by original contracts and fill dates. Missing evidence is refused; account capital and unexplained residuals are never allocated.
合约贡献导出包含全部原合约、交易日、成交、核对项及未解释差额；页面筛选和分页不缩: Contract contribution exports contain every original contract, trading day, fill, check and unexplained residual. View selections and pagination do not narrow the fixed account scope.
使用固定权重组合政策（仅完整普通日线）: Use a fixed-weight portfolio policy (complete ordinary daily sources only)
此政策替代普通CTA规则；编辑工作区政策不创建任务，明确开始回测后才接纳。不提供: This policy replaces the ordinary CTA rule. Editing the workspace does not create a task; only explicitly starting the backtest admits it. It does not authorize live execution.
需要2至20个同币种、整数步长的普通日线合约；不支持主连、分钟线或单合约候选绑定: Requires 2 to 20 ordinary daily contracts with one currency and whole-lot increments. Dominant series, minute bars and single-contract candidate bindings are unsupported.
每隔共同完整bar调仓（1–10000，必填）: Rebalance every common completed bars (1–10000, required)
正权重做多、负权重做空、明确0为归零目标；缺失权重不补0。预算超限拒绝，不归一化: Positive weights are long, negative short, and explicit zero targets flat. Missing weights are not zero. Budget violations are refused without normalization or size reduction.
请明确填写全部合约权重、非负总净预算及调仓间隔；权重绝对和与净额必须在预算内。: Enter every contract weight, nonnegative gross/net budgets and a rebalance interval. Gross and net weights must stay within the declared budgets.
固定组合目标与实际执行: Fixed portfolio targets and actual execution
只读原计算的共同边界权益、目标和实际成交关联；不在页面重算手数、收益或费用。: Read original common-boundary equity, targets and actual fill associations. The view does not recalculate lots, returns or fees.
名义余量不是现金，不自动转配；实际持仓和在途与目标分列，资金或风控拒绝不等于改小: Nominal remainder is not cash and is never redistributed. Actual positions and working orders remain separate from targets; funding or risk refusal does not reduce the original target.
原bar边界不证明资料当时已可得；本结果仍是固定资料的离线条件研究，不是独立验证: Original bar boundaries do not establish historical data availability. This remains offline conditional research on fixed evidence, not independent validation or live authorization.
未到声明的共同调仓边界，没有生成组合目标。: No declared common rebalance boundary was reached; no portfolio target was generated.
有后续bar，不保证成交: A later bar exists; fills are not guaranteed
末边界，无后续bar成交: Final boundary: no later bar to fill
查看原组合目标与成交: Inspect original portfolio targets and fills
所选原组合目标与成交: Selected original portfolio targets and fills
所选原整数目标与余量: Selected original whole-lot targets and remainders
原组合意图的实际成交: Actual fills for original portfolio intents
本轮未记录实际成交，不将目标或委托当作成交。: No actual fill was recorded for this round; targets and orders are not fills.
每个共同收盘边界用当时账户权益与明确有符号权重生成整数目标，向零取整；余量不计现: At common completed closes, boundary account equity and explicit signed weights produce whole-lot targets truncated toward zero. Remainders are neither cash nor redistributed; fills occur no earlier than a later bar.
组合政策不完整，尚不能进入运行确认。: The portfolio policy is incomplete; running confirmation is unavailable.
委托状态取自原回测终点，不冒充决策边界的在途；日单余量到期不代表原目标已完成。: Order status is the original replay endpoint, not working state at the decision boundary. Expired DAY remainders do not mean the target was reached.
原组合意图的实际接纳委托: Actual orders accepted for the original portfolio intent
本轮未记录实际接纳委托，不将目标当作已发送订单。: No accepted order was recorded for this decision; a target is not a sent order.
原持仓捕获于共同bar成交及日单到期处理后、新目标接纳前；保留真实今昨多空批次，: Original lots follow common-bar execution and DAY expiry, before the new target is admitted; today/yesterday and long/short lots are not reconstructed from endpoint holdings.
原调仓边界实际持仓批次: Original position lots at the rebalance boundary
原边界持仓已知为空，不代表原目标已完成。: Original boundary holdings are known to be empty; this does not mean the target was reached.
当前日线截面已处理所属日单到期，原工作委托已知为空；新目标仍不是已接纳委托。: DAY orders have expired at this daily observation; original working orders are known to be empty, and the new target is not yet an accepted order.
冻结正式回测中的固定决策定义: Freeze a fixed decision definition from a formal backtest

所选数据需按原顺序匹配固定包的全部合约、单位和周期: Selected data must match every contract, unit and interval in the fixed package, in original order.
新配置锁定全部组合政策，需另行确认Data版本、资金、费用与风险；打开配置不接纳: A new configuration locks the complete portfolio policy and requires explicit Data version, funds, costs and risk. Opening it admits no task.
按固定组合新配置回测: Configure a new backtest from the fixed portfolio
全部合约、权重、预算和调仓间隔来自固定包；请显式确认本次Data版本、资金、费用: Every contract, weight, budget and rebalance interval comes from the fixed package. Explicitly confirm the Data version, funds, costs and risk for this run.
只改变一项成本，其余固定输入不变；结果与原回测在比较中并列查看。: Changes one cost and keeps every other fixed input; compare the result side by side with the original backtest.
观测不足一年，不年化: Shorter than one year; not annualized
来源公布时间未知。结果用于事后统计与回放，不能证明历史当时可交易。: The source's publication time is unknown. Results support after-the-fact statistics and replay; they cannot prove the history was tradable at the time.

HTML和CSV均保留缺项和失败原因。请选择新本地文件，已有文件不会覆盖；失败不: Both HTML and CSV retain missing evidence and unavailable reasons. Choose a new local file; existing files are not overwritten. Failure does not change the saved report.
